checks.title: A Paho MQTT 3.1.1 client publishes at QoS 0 to its own events topic and the measurement is stored with the value sent
A Paho MQTT 3.1.1 client publishes at QoS 1, the broker acknowledges it, and the measurement is stored with the value sent
A command issued to a device with a live subscription on its command topic reaches that device, and the device's response settles the command as SUCCESSFUL
POST /{instance}/{tenant}/events with a valid event answers 202 and the measurement is stored
A tenant over its ingest ceiling is answered 429 with a Retry-After header and the refused event is not stored
While the platform applies backpressure, an event is answered 503 with a Retry-After header and is not stored
An Eclipse Leshan client registers over DTLS-PSK, the device is created, and its presence reads connected
The platform observes the Leshan client's temperature object and the notified values are stored as measurements
A lwm2m.read command reads the Leshan client's Device manufacturer and returns the value the client holds, in the content format the client answered with
A lwm2m.write command changes the Leshan client's time zone, and a read afterwards returns the value written
A lwm2m.execute command of the Device object's Reboot resource is answered by the Leshan client and settles as SUCCESSFUL
The named lwm2m.reboot command is answered by the Leshan client and settles as SUCCESSFUL

Against Eclipse Leshan, which answers a single-resource Read that carries no Accept option in TLV, the named lwm2m.readDeviceInfo command reads no resource and fails, naming the content format it does not decode
Against the same client, the registration-time harvest records no manufacturer client attribute
A LwM2M 1.0-style client that can encode TLV but not SenML registers and shows as connected, and no telemetry is stored for it
A Tahu edge node's NBIRTH registers the node as a device and its presence reads connected
A Tahu edge node's NDATA, addressed by alias, is stored under the metric the birth gave that alias, with the value sent
